bfsi.reason: FBI attributed the Bybit theft (~US$1.5B, Feb 2025) and, with Japan's NPA, the DMM Bitcoin theft (~US$308M, May 2024) to DPRK "TraderTraitor"; TRM Labs attributed KelpDAO (~US$292M, Apr 2026) to TraderTraitor. No ATT&CK group object exists (verified v20.1).

description: TraderTraitor is the FBI's name for North Korean (DPRK) cyber activity focused on stealing cryptocurrency from exchanges and other crypto-finance firms. The FBI attributed the February 2025 theft of roughly US$1.5 billion from the Bybit exchange to TraderTraitor (the operation manipulated the signing interface of a multisig cold wallet during a transfer), and, together with Japan's National Police Agency, the May 2024 theft of about US$308 million from DMM Bitcoin. Vendor reporting tracks overlapping activity as Jade Sleet, UNC4899 and Slow Pisces; these names overlap with, but are not exact equivalents of, APT38 (BlueNoroff/Sapphire Sleet) and Lazarus Group. MITRE ATT&CK has no TraderTraitor group object, so this page lists only analyst-reviewed mappings from public reporting.
